title: Irrigation Maintenance Checklist Form
subtitle: Irrigation route the work, prepare controls, record tasks and parts, test the result, manage unresolved conditions, and authorize return to use.
description: An original, workflow-complete irrigation maintenance checklist covering identity and routing, domain observations and evidence, accountable decisions, exceptions and escalation, and completion handoff without replacing qualified judgment.
use_case: Use for scheduled or corrective maintenance that needs task evidence, measurements, parts traceability, function checks, restrictions, and handoff. The record is owned by the irrigation operations owner and closes only after evidence, exceptions, disposition, and the next accountable handoff are documented.

sections.title: Irrigation maintenance routing
sections.guidance: Identify the work, subject, assigned person, and review owner.

blocks.label: Maintenance Checklist identity and routing
blocks.guidance: Assign one owner and use the same record ID in attachments and follow-up.

blocks.label: Irrigation Run Or Zone identity
blocks.guidance: Preserve the identifiers used by the controlling farm, facility, or partner record.

sections.title: Irrigation work preparation
sections.guidance: Record instructions, condition, controls, and parts before work.

blocks.label: Pre-work review and controls
items: Source, pump, meter, and zone identity were recorded
Schedule or agronomic instruction reference was recorded
Starting and ending meter values were captured
Pressure, flow, and distribution observations were recorded
Filter, valve, emitter, or sprinkler condition was noted
Runoff, ponding, leaks, or blocked areas were identified
Weather, rainfall, and soil or crop context was noted
Variance, shutdown, and follow-up ownership were recorded

sections.title: Irrigation maintenance tasks
sections.guidance: Record completed tasks separately from measurements and findings.

blocks.label: Irrigation task checklist
items: System shutdown and energy-control status were recorded
Pump, motor, drive, and mounting condition were observed
Filters, screens, and flushing records were reviewed
Valves, regulators, gauges, and controllers were checked
Mainlines, laterals, fittings, and repairs were examined
Emitters, nozzles, sprinklers, and outlet flow were sampled
Meters, sensors, timers, and alarms were function-checked
Backflow or injection components were routed for qualified service
Leaks, erosion, runoff, and water-quality concerns were escalated
Test run, readings, and return-to-service status were recorded

sections.title: Irrigation parts and service evidence
sections.guidance: Preserve material, service, and removed-part traceability.

blocks.label: Work performed, deviations from plan, and supporting references

sections.title: Irrigation function test and decision
sections.guidance: Separate the test evidence from return-to-use authorization.

blocks.label: Function and handback evidence
items: Irrigation before-and-after results support the recorded status
Tasks, measurements, parts, and outside service are documented
Function testing is separate from return-to-use authorization
Restrictions and unfinished work have owners and due points
Qualified review was obtained where work or disposition exceeds authority

sections.title: Irrigation unresolved conditions
sections.guidance: Preserve restrictions and route decisions beyond the maintainer’s authority.

blocks.label: Maintenance authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This record supports irrigation operations but does not set agronomic, water-quality, electrical, backflow, or injection requirements. Stop and route abnormal conditions to the qualified owner under current site procedures.

blocks.label: Irrigation unresolved-condition triggers
items: Source, meter, pump, or zone identity mismatch
Pressure, flow, volume, or run-time variance
Leak, blockage, runoff, ponding, or distribution gap
Sensor, controller, valve, or alarm failure
Water-quality, backflow, or injection concern
Allocation, access, crop instruction, or repair authority gap

blocks.label: Restriction, immediate action, owner, due point, and final disposition

sections.title: Irrigation maintenance closeout
sections.guidance: Transfer restrictions, next service, and evidence to operations.

blocks.label: Irrigation open actions and limitations
blocks.guidance: Carry forward every item that is not fully resolved at closeout.

blocks.label: Irrigation handoff confirmations
items: Work, measurements, parts, and removed material were reconciled
Restrictions and unfinished work were transferred to operations
Next maintenance, inspection, or verification point was assigned
Irrigation return-to-use handback was acknowledged
Work records, manuals, photos, and service evidence were filed
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items remain part of the open handoff.

blocks.label: Final outcome, remaining limits, communications, and acceptance notes
